programme.desc: Shaun and his chums awake to find the farm covered in snow!

programme.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
programme.desc: The Jedi help a young bounty hunter track down her brother.

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Romeo resents the PJs new animal powers, so he invents some robotic animal "powers" of his own.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: After a tropical storm carries a little goby out to sea, the Vegimals and Kwazii set off to return him to his home atop a waterfall. The steep climb doesn't pose a problem for the goby until his predators arrive.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends
programme.desc: When Thomas finds a treasure map he creates "The Big Adventure Club," to seek the treasure, but when Sandy wants to join, Thomas says she's too little, so Sandy forms her own club.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Twenty enters the Pattern Palace to find out who his Twenty-friends are. Learn about number bonds to 20 with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Mittens & Pants

programme.title: Fantus And The Machines
programme.desc: A car transporter can carry up to 8 cars. Come and see for yourself with Fantus.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it's Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

programme.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programme.desc: The Wiggles are babysitting baby Dorothy, but she won't fall asleep! They try feeding her and singing, but nothing seems to work. They call Captain Feathersword, the sleeping specialist, to help them out.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Shaun finds some musical whistles that command the flock to move involuntarily. It's great fun until the Farmer decides to play a tune of his own!

programme.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programme.desc: It's Halloween and Paddington goes Treat or Treating with Jonathan and Judy around Windsor Gardens, but Mr Curry does not want to join in. or does he? And why is Mrs Bird not scared at all?

programme.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
programme.desc: Tony, Riri, and Amadeus try to fix Howard Stark's failed invention, but it causes chaos at Stark Expo.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: Mum has set up the playroom as a puzzle room for the kids, but when Pranksy locks the door, the spies must play all the puzzles to escape.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: When The Spidey Team is planning to stop Green Goblin, he manages to throw the heroes' plans off course

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Fergie is feeling off, Vida diagnoses her - she's having a sad day.

programme.title: Flower & Flour

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: After watching their favourite television programme, 'Detective Potato', Peppa and George want to be famous detectives too. So, Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve. Teddy is hidden and Peppa and George try to find him.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs

programme.title: Kangaroo Beach
programme.desc: Worried about scuba diving for the first time, Neville runs off in the middle of the night.

programme.title: Fizzy And Suds

programme.title: HexVets And Magic Pets
programme.desc: A giant bullfrog stampede teaches the ever-helpful Clarion an important lesson.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 106 million years to the time of muttaburrasaurus, a nine-metre-long dinosaur that lived in Australia.

programme.title: Play School

programme.title: Fireman Sam
programme.desc: Moose teaches the kids how to slowly cook potatoes outdoors, but their hunger makes them impatient and soon lunch is the least of their worries.
